## The Project from Back to Front

### Goal

- creating a "map of the field": What research has been done on the **interaction of consumers and technology**?
- having this map of the field as a **starting point** for **expert discussions by the people who shape the fiel**d at the CTD26
- Using this map of the field to illustrate gaps and define future research agendas 
    - Reverse temporality: Which theories and concepts of the past apply to the future
    - Essences of technology: To what extent are the connections of concepts that form theories dependent on the technology. Can we reverse-engineer the essence from it?
